sections.label: Clinical experience
items: Hands-on inpatient experience working directly alongside residents and faculty at Keralty Hospital.
Outpatient clinic exposure complementing the hospital-based component.
Full EMR access throughout the rotation.
Documents must be submitted 28 days prior to your start date.

sections.label: Eligibility
items: USMLE Step 1 required before enrolling.
Rotation starts on the first Monday of each month.
Maximum of 2 students per rotation cycle.

detail.lor_text: If you perform well throughout the rotation, you have a chance to earn a LOR on hospital letterhead — and potentially an interview opportunity.
